domain_contagion.en: Same site as a removed page
domain_contagion.zh: 與已移除頁面同一網站

folder_contagion.zh: 含已移除頁面的資料夾

sub.en: Your bookmarks are read in this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded. Only the places you approve are looked up.
sub.zh: 書籤只在這個瀏覽器分頁內讀取，不會上傳。只有你同意的場所類別才會被查詢。

s1help.en: Export from Chrome: Bookmark Manager, menu, Export bookmarks. Or try the sample.
s1help.zh: 從 Chrome 匯出：書籤管理員、選單、匯出書籤。也可以先試範例。

read.zh: 在瀏覽器內讀取的連結

s2note.en: Only counts are shown for removed links. Their text is not stored and not displayed.
s2note.zh: 已移除的連結只顯示數量，內容不會儲存也不會顯示。

s3.en: 3. What do you want from your time off?
s3.zh: 3. 你想從休閒時間得到什麼？

s3help.en: Pick any. This is your choice, not a guess about you.
s3help.zh: 可以任選。這是你自己的選擇，不是對你的推測。

payload.en: If you continue, only this goes out:

nomatch.en: Nothing matched yet. Pick what you want from your time off above.
nomatch.zh: 目前沒有符合的項目。請在上面選擇你想要的。

via.en: No dedicated listing in this city, showing:
via.zh: 此城市沒有專屬資料，改顯示：

noplaces.en: Qloo has no listing of this kind for this city (limited data).
noplaces.zh: Qloo 在這個城市沒有這類場所的資料（資料較少）。

offline.en: The place lookup service is not connected in this build yet.
offline.zh: 場所查詢服務尚未連上。

too_many.en: Up to {max} categories per lookup; {n} are checked. Uncheck {extra} to continue.
too_many.zh: 一次最多查 {max} 個類別，目前勾選 {n} 個，請取消 {extra} 個再查詢。

err_request.en: The server did not accept this lookup (for example, more than 12 categories). Uncheck a few and try again.
err_request.zh: 伺服器不接受這次查詢（例如類別超過 12 個），請少勾幾個再試。

err_slow.en: Too many lookups in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
err_slow.zh: 短時間內查詢太多次，請等一分鐘再試。

err_budget.en: This month's lookup allowance has been used up.
err_budget.zh: 本月的查詢額度已用完。

err_network.en: The connection dropped before the places arrived (weak signal, or the page went to the background). Check the network and press Find places again.
err_network.zh: 場所還沒傳回來連線就中斷了（訊號不穩，或頁面被切到背景）。請確認網路後再按一次查詢場所。

err_server.en: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
err_server.zh: 伺服器暫時出了問題，請稍後再試。

ai_title.zh: 用裝置上的比對找出更多

ai_help.en: Optional. A small language model (about 120 MB, downloaded once and kept in your browser) compares the titles that matched nothing with the activities, so paraphrases are found too. Your bookmarks still never leave this tab.
ai_help.zh: 可選。一個小型語言模型（約 120 MB，只下載一次、存在你的瀏覽器裡）把沒有比對到的標題和活動做語意比對，換句話說也找得到。你的書籤仍然不會離開這個分頁。

ai_unsupported.en: This browser cannot run WebAssembly, so on-device matching is skipped. Keyword matching still works.
ai_unsupported.zh: 這個瀏覽器無法執行 WebAssembly，已略過裝置上的比對。關鍵字比對仍可使用。

ai_error.en: The model could not start here. Keyword matching still works.
ai_error.zh: 模型無法在這裡啟動。關鍵字比對仍可使用。

diag_note.en: Only a city and place-category ids go out.
diag_note.zh: 只有城市與場所類別編號會送出。

payload_title.zh: 會離開你裝置的全部內容

foot.en: Places come from Qloo. Open source, MIT license.
foot.zh: 場所資料來自 Qloo。開源，MIT 授權。

ideas_hint.en: Untick anything you do not want looked up.
ideas_hint.zh: 不想查的可以取消勾選。

theme_hint.en: Style changes only the look. Alt+S opens this menu.
theme_hint.zh: 風格只改外觀。Alt+S 可開關這個選單。

taste_title.en: Go deeper with places you saved (optional)
taste_title.zh: 用你收藏過的店再深入（可選）

taste_help.en: Names taken from your bookmark titles. Tick up to 5 and Qloo ranks places by taste similar to them, not only by category. A ticked name is sent to Qloo and shows in the box below. Nothing is ticked by default.
taste_help.zh: 從你的書籤標題取出的名稱。最多勾選 5 個，Qloo 會依與它們相近的品味排序，而不只看類別。勾選的名稱會送給 Qloo，並顯示在下方方框。預設都不勾選。

taste_none.en: No names to suggest from these bookmarks.
taste_none.zh: 這些書籤沒有可建議的名稱。

taste_unknown.en: Qloo did not recognise these names, so they were not used:
taste_unknown.zh: Qloo 不認得這些名稱，因此沒有使用：

taste_differs.zh: 個場所因你的品味而不同

quality_help.en: Ask Qloo for refined, minimalist, artisan places and leave out anything rated below 4.3. Adds one setting to the box below.
quality_help.zh: 請 Qloo 優先找精緻、簡約、手作質感的場所，並排除評分低於 4.3 的。會在下方方框多一個設定。

quality_relaxed.en: Nothing met the quality bar here, so the ordinary list is shown for:
quality_relaxed.zh: 這裡沒有場所達到質感門檻，因此改顯示一般清單：

quality_changed.zh: 個場所因質感優先而不同

expand_help.en: Ideas that sit next to the ones you ticked. They describe activities, not you. Nothing is ticked by default; a ticked one is added to the box below.
expand_help.zh: 和你勾選的點子相鄰的活動。描述的是活動，不是你這個人。預設都不勾選；勾選後會加進下方方框。

invite_step.en: Start small: one hour, one friend. These are places, not events, and opening hours are not checked.
invite_step.zh: 小步開始：先約一小時，找一個人一起。這裡列的是場所，不是活動場次，也沒有核對營業時間。

invite_more_two.en: Or want to {verb}? How about {a} or {b}?

occasion_tw.en: Taiwan holidays and international days. Dates are from public sources: check your own work calendar.
occasion_tw.zh: 含台灣假期與國際節日，日期取自公開資料，請以你自己的工作行事曆為準。

evidence_title.en: Evidence: every Qloo request behind this page
evidence_title.zh: 證據：這個頁面背後的每一筆 Qloo 請求

evidence_help.en: Endpoint, parameters, status, time and result count, exactly as sent. The API key is never shown. Cached means answered from this server's memory, not a new request.
evidence_help.zh: 端點、參數、狀態、耗時與結果數，與實際送出的一致。API 金鑰不會顯示。「快取」代表由伺服器記憶體回答，不是新的請求。

invite_friend_done.en: Copied. Paste it into your chat.
invite_friend_done.zh: 已複製，貼到你的聊天裡。

invite_msg.en: {when}: want to do this together? {line} A place to start: {place}.
invite_msg.zh: {when}，要不要一起？{line} 可以從這裡開始：{place}。

waiting_line.en: {months} months ago you saved “{title}”. Is this the weekend?
waiting_line.zh: {months} 個月前你收藏了「{title}」。這個週末是不是時候？

waiting_chip.zh: 最早收藏於 {months} 個月前

taste_untasted.en: Your saved place gave Qloo nothing to rank these by, so the ordinary list is shown for:
taste_untasted.zh: 你收藏的場所無法為這些類別排序，因此改顯示一般清單：

heat_title.en: Where the taste of {names} clusters in {city}

heat_help.en: Qloo's taste heatmap for the places you ticked: the {n} strongest of {total} cells, bigger and darker where the affinity is higher. White rings are places on this page. No map tiles are loaded.
heat_help.zh: Qloo 依你勾選的場所算出的品味熱區圖：{total} 個格子中最強的 {n} 個，越大越深代表相符度越高。白圈是本頁的場所。不載入任何地圖圖資。

heat_none.en: Qloo has no heatmap for this taste in this city.
heat_none.zh: Qloo 沒有這個品味在這個城市的熱區資料。

heat_failed.en: The heatmap request did not succeed this time; the places above are unaffected.
heat_failed.zh: 這次的熱區查詢沒有成功，上面的場所不受影響。

heat_alt.en: Taste heatmap: dots sized by Qloo affinity, rings for places on this page
heat_alt.zh: 品味熱區圖：圓點大小代表相符度，圓圈是本頁場所

business_talk.en: talk business at an easy pace
